finalText:
Migration finished. 12 files still on `db.query` — 33 call sites — now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`:

- `packages/accounts`: `repo/session.js`, `service/teamService.js`, `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`
- `packages/billing`: `repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js`
- `packages/catalog`: `repo/supplier.js`, `admin/variantAdmin.js`
- `packages/orders`: `repo/shipment.js`, `service/returnService.js`
- `packages/support`: `repo/sla.js`, `admin/macroAdmin.js`
- `packages/analytics`: `repo/cohort.js`

All files pass `node --check`. No test suite or package.json in the repo to run.

Two things I deliberately left alone:

- **`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`** (2 call sites) — header says it's a vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4, replaced wholesale on upgrade with local edits silently lost. Since `db.query` is deprecated and slated for removal in the driver's next major, this needs a fix upstream or a wrapper at the boundary rather than an edit here. Flagging it as the one remaining consumer.
- **`cache.query(...)`** in ~20 files — different object, unrelated API.

`db.query` itself is still defined in `lib/db.js:13`; say the word if you want it removed now that the only in-repo caller is vendored.
